# MG_Translater

> Electron desktop-first manga image editor. React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript renderer inside an Electron shell, with Konva canvas editing, PanelCleaner/Ollama local AI, and Cloudflare Worker/D1/R2 album storage.

MG_Translater uses Konva/react-konva for the canvas editor, local PanelCleaner and Ollama integrations for image cleanup and OCR/translation, and a Cloudflare Worker with D1/R2 for album persistence. Electron V1 is the primary acceptance target; the web runtime is a fallback and CI path.

## Commands

- Install: `npm install`
- Dev: `npm run dev`
- Build: `npm run build`
- Tests: `npm test`
- Focused editor tests: `npm run test:editor`
- Worker dry run: `npm run worker:check`
- Refresh repo context: `npm run context:refresh`

## Agent Rules

- Read `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/AGENTS.md` first.
- For multi-agent work, read `.agents/team.md` before splitting ownership.
- For Konva/canvas work, read `docs/llm/konva.md` before changing editor interaction code.
- For research or repeated questions, read `_wiki/podcast.md`, `_wiki/index.md`, then only relevant wiki pages.
- Treat `Clippings/` as local-only raw Web Clipper source material.
- Preserve Thai text as UTF-8.
